title: Constructible restriction of normalized operation scalar transport
statement: Let $\ell$ be prime, $E,L$ finite extensions of $\mathbf Q_\ell$, $\iota:E\to L$ a $\mathbf Q_\ell$-embedding, and $W$ a scheme. Let $T$ be a pure-tensor and derived-counit normalized OperationScalarTransport [def-pur-operation-scalar-transport]. Write $j_E,j_L$ for the ambient inclusions of the intrinsic integral constructible categories [def-sf-operation-stages], and $C_\iota$ for their actual integral scalar extension [def-weil-integral-scalar-extension]. Define operationConstructibleScalarTransport to be the natural isomorphism $j_L\circ C_\iota\cong L\phi^*\circ j_E$, where $\phi$ is the completed coefficient map. It is exactly the inverse of the recorded ordinary-model identification sfIntegralOrdinaryComparison, followed by whiskering $T.\mathrm{derived}$ with $j_E$. Thus the restriction retains the pure-tensor and universal-derived-counit normalization of $T$, and introduces no independent natural-isomorphism choice. This definition takes $T$ as data and makes no assertion that such data exist.
